title: Derived-number matching explained almost any fabricated number

found.context: Stage 1 calibration of verify_numbers against a real paper

observed_failure: Allowing any difference/ratio of any two source numbers as a 'derived' match explained 38 of 40 deliberately fabricated numbers.
expected_behavior: A number is derived only from the evidence items cited by the claim(s) on the same line; otherwise it is untraced.

resolution.summary: derivation restricted to same-line cited evidence; probe now catches 35/40

lessons: A lenient checker is worse than none: it certifies fabrication.
